notes: Baseline of revision 77a63a8 plus temporary pv:* stage instrumentation (usePdfCanvasPreview.tsx and pdfCanvasRenderer.ts). The 1 and 2 page sizes come from the first run; the 5 and 10 page sizes were re-run with the final harness, whose settle window grows with page count (the first run ended some 10 page windows before the update arrived). Harness: tooling/bench-preview.mjs. Chromium headless, 1440x900, deviceScaleFactor 1. A later re-run of typing-normal and zoom on an otherwise idle machine (quietRecheck, same build, same fixtures) agreed with the recorded values within about 10 percent (10 page typing-normal visible p50 848 ms quiet vs 934 ms recorded; long task max 358 vs 495 ms), so the recorded values stand. firstPreviewMs and the rss*/resources fields come from the quiet re-run, because the original harness did not collect them.
